overall_summary: Analysis of 26 Shorts reveals highest performance on macro space phenomena and global atmospheric catastrophe scenarios with explicit time-bound triggers (e.g., '5 seconds'). Top performing uploads include 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' (1,059 studio views, 268 min watch time, 50.79% AVP) and 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' (880 studio views, 262 min watch time, 64.42% AVP). Content focused on minor aesthetic shifts or lower-stakes physics changes suffers from steep early retention drop-offs.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 880 studio views, 262 minutes estimated watch time, and 64.42% average view percentage.
what_is_working.action: Double down on existential planet-wide scenarios tied to brief, high-stakes time constraints (3-10 seconds).

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' gained 1,059 studio views and 268 estimated minutes watched; 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' generated 679 studio views.
what_is_working.action: Prioritize celestial transformation scenarios with high visual impact and universal awe.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth's Atmosphere Turned Neon Pink?' achieved only 29.93% AVP (18s AVD); 'What If Water Lost All Surface Tension?' had relative retention drop to 0.0622 by 49% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Avoid abstract/aesthetic shifts; frame physics questions around dramatic, immediate survival consequences.

what_to_improve.evidence: Identical titles uploaded within seconds of each other ('Earth Had Rings Like Saturn' at 04:55 and 04:56; 'Earth Lost Its Magnetic Field' at 19:39).
what_to_improve.action: Implement strict publish checks to prevent accidental duplicate postings that cannibalize reach.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' retained audience watch ratio above 1.11x through 10% progress and maintained 0.60x at 49% progress.
retention_insights.action: Deliver instant visual and auditory payoff in the first 2 seconds showing immediate global impact before explaining mechanisms.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Water Lost All Surface Tension?' relative retention fell from 0.5094 at 1% progress to 0.2303 at 10% progress.
retention_insights.action: Replace explanatory verbal preambles with high-velocity visual transformation sequences within 0.05 progress.

best_posting_windows.reason: Top performing video ('What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?', 1,059 views) and strong performer ('What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?', 679 views) were published between 04:47 UTC and 04:56 UTC.
Highest watch time video ('What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?', 262 min watch time, 64.42% AVP) was published at 12:08 UTC.
